meta.title: Websites for local businesses
meta.description: Atomic IT builds modern websites for small businesses. Clear pricing, simple process, no tech jargon.

hero.lead: Modern websites for local businesses and professionals. One person, one owner: from the first call to launch.

trusted.label: Who we help
trusted.title: Built for people who show up in person.
trusted.lead: Clinics, salons, workshops, law firms, local services — businesses where trust starts face to face, then continues online.

services.title:
A site that works.
Not just looks pretty.
services.lead: Three services, one goal: make it easy for customers to find you and get in touch.

new.title: New business website
new.text: From scratch: design, copy, mobile, and launch. Simple and modern.

refresh.title: Website refresh
refresh.text: Have a site that isn’t helping? We’ll clean it up and modernize it.

care.title: Care after launch
care.text: Updates, copy tweaks, and small changes — one contact, clear rules.

problem.title:
A website done
“on the side” doesn’t sell.
problem.lead: Too often it’s rushed, looks cheap, and nobody knows how to maintain it. You don’t need another promise — you need clear ownership.
problem.beforeCaption: Scattered ownership, vague quotes, and a site that doesn’t earn trust.
problem.afterCaption: One person, clear price, visible progress — from first call to launch.

bad.a: An old site — or none at all

good.a: One person runs the whole thing
good.c: You see progress along the way

steps.title:
From the first message
to a live website.
steps.lead: Three steps. Clear price before we start. No dragging it out.

talk.title: We talk
talk.text: A short call about your business and needs. Then you get a clear quote — no pressure.

build.title: We build
build.text: Design, copy, and development in one place. You see the site take shape as we go.

live.title: We launch
live.text: We publish calmly and stay available when something needs changing.

work.title:
Simple websites.
Clear outcomes.
work.lead: Example directions for local businesses — so the site helps people get in touch.

a.title: A clear service site
a.text: Offer, trust, and easy contact on mobile.

b.title: A modern calling card
b.text: A first impression that feels solid.

c.title: A site with a clear CTA
c.text: What you do, who it’s for, and how to reach you.

fit.title:
Not for everyone.
And that’s fine.
fit.lead: It works best with trust and collaboration. Better to say it upfront.

no.a: You want miracles for zero budget
no.b: You can’t spare a moment for short decisions
no.c: You want to control every pixel for months

yes.a: You know what you do and who you serve
yes.b: You want a site that builds trust
yes.c: You hand over the “how” and judge the result

cta.title:
Book a free
20-minute call.
cta.lead: We’ll talk about your business, where you are, and where you want to go. If I can help, I’ll say how. If not, you’ll hear that too.

c.title: You talk to a real person

footer.tagline: Websites for businesses that prefer calm over tech chaos.
